tasks.description: 1.1 Freeze relevant dirty source identities, minimal known-case evidence, input/toolchain provenance, and exclusions; verify historical reports and unrelated work remain unchanged in a baseline manifest.

1.2 Freeze the public command, structured-fragment, result-dimension, and resource contract for M1; independently challenge it and observe meaningful red tests for unavailable application extraction and missing correspondence checking.

1.3 Run the bounded feasibility check on tactic-style and term-style portable proofs plus one named real application; verify exact instantiated arguments/context and local replay, or preserve the concrete failure and revise the route before dependent expansion.
1.4 Document the supported extraction profile and measured bounds with actual helper receipts; verify the documented local-checkout invocation reproduces the feasibility result.

2.1 Implement the minimal scoped interpretation and closed native payload producers/validators; verify faithful renaming, quantifier order, stale source, unsupported expressions, unknown fields, and exact references through the ordinary CLI.

2.2 Implement the selected local application slice using package A's observed route; verify actual implicit arguments, local values, source attribution, ordered premise occurrences, and explicit unexpanded providers.

2.3 Implement scope-preserving interpretation lowering, object-map elaboration, and original premise-supply/conclusion-transfer goals; verify structural-versus-Lean quantifier mismatches, invented hypotheses, self-dependencies, and silent goal changes with positive and adversarial real Lean checks.

2.4 Connect bounded supplied terms to source-goal capture/completion and native attempts/check-runs; verify a faithful control closes by independent replay and a false portable interpretation is refuted by its own checked evidence.

2.5 Exercise the same public path on the selected real passage/application; save supported links and all remaining physical/object/quantifier obligations, with independent interpretation review and no stronger finding than the receipts establish.
2.6 Publish an executable M1 usage example and acceptance report; verify every M1 condition before starting generalized extraction, search, or additional checker families.

3.1 Extend slices to a bounded multi-step example with local have-proofs, witnesses, and branches; verify all AND premises and reject escaped witnesses, unavailable later facts, and swapped instantiations.

3.2 Add scoped ambiguity and constant/witness dependency comparisons; verify pointwise versus uniform obligations remain distinct while valid alpha-renaming and checked representation transport remain accepted.

3.3 Implement separate conditional, premise-provider, parent-support, fidelity, and method outcomes; verify a false predecessor does not refute a valid downstream conditional and a valid alternate proof does not certify the described method.
3.4 Exercise depth/node/expression/process bounds and unsupported source forms; verify explicit residual frontiers, no lossy complete results, and no stale acceptance after context changes.

3.5 Document the supported multi-step fragment and qualify one real multi-step slice; verify guide examples and keep general analytic arguments outside available replay labeled as attributed evidence.

4.1 Integrate opt-in investigation v3 authoring, native inspection/projection, and shared immutable references; verify one authored record reaches checking, challenge export, and queue inspection without retyping its contract.

4.2 Integrate sanitized independent response ingestion and reconciliation; verify original first responses survive corrections, changed contexts require actual new review, and reviewer assignments can be replayed without exposing prior assessments.

4.3 Integrate discrepancy priority and independent mathematical/formal completion dimensions; verify absent counterparts, budget exhaustion, unsupported interpretation, and unexamined source remain visible without invented evidence.

4.4 Reproduce the recorded declaration-compaction and option-routing failures with minimized current inputs; fix demonstrated consuming-path defects or preserve a precise non-reproduction, with tests retaining malformed-container rejection and honest help behavior.

4.5 Verify v1/v2 compatibility, old artifact identities, bounded native query/projection, explicit unsupported-kind behavior, and operation without Quux; update CLI guides and packaged skill and execute their examples from the local checkout.

5.1 Independently prepare and freeze the eight-case actual-Lean population, separate justified key, source-selection inputs, budgets, case/arm order, and scoring; verify no development answer or selected fault leaks into auditor inputs.

5.2 Run fresh assisted and ordinary-tool contexts with matched resource and reviewer policies; preserve every first response, command, source identity, timing, omission, and exposure before revealing the key.

5.3 Replay claimed checks and refutations, adjudicate source fidelity and disputed references, and normalize case verdicts; verify aggregate counts equal the scored rows and preserve corrections separately from frozen first results.

5.4 Publish paired case-level findings, controls, abstentions, cost, and an explicit benefit or unmet-benefit decision; verify the report distinguishes constructed/real-source evidence, development/held-out cases, and procedural/enforced isolation.

6.1 After the final production edit, run focused changed-module and parent CLI, source-goal, native-v3, derivation, investigation, and rendering consumers plus relevant quality/resource gates; preserve actual command receipts and ensure required Lean-backed gates are not silently skipped.

6.2 Obtain an independent integrated audit of the final code, contracts, trust boundary, and evaluation claims; reconcile actionable findings and re-run affected gates after any fixes, preserving frozen acceptance tests.

6.3 Run strict OpenSpec validation and final source/historical-evidence checks; record capability coverage, exact limitations, evaluation outcome, and reproducible local-checkout commands in the integration report before marking the umbrella implemented.
